title: Secrets Management Missions
subtitle: These challenges reinforce secure secret handling across code, CI/CD, infrastructure, incident response and AI-assisted work.

scenarios.title: Release Gate: Stop the Secret From Shipping
scenarios.summary: Review a Node.js merge request, remove linked exposure paths and verify the correction.

scenarios.title: Pipeline Containment: The Masked Value Trap
scenarios.summary: Make a pipeline decision, see the consequence, investigate the evidence and recover safely.

scenarios.title: Terraform Boundary: Redacted Is Not Removed
scenarios.summary: Interpret sensitive handling correctly and keep secret material out of source, plans and shared artifacts.

scenarios.title: Exposure Response: Contain Before Cleanup
scenarios.summary: Respond to a scanner finding using the correct priority for active or already-inactive credentials.

scenarios.title: AI Context Control: Share the Problem, Not the Secret
scenarios.summary: Control assistant context, review generated code and respond safely to suspected disclosure.
